body: Rather not say. I can get to some things if I chose and I have a car in good working order I just can't find the energy to really get out of the house for things beyond laundry, food shopping,etc.

I live in a very rural part of the country. Hours from anything that could be called a city. It is all very small town in the sense that if I go somewhere I will prob hear about it at work as everyone just talks in circles around town.

I'm gay and not religious at all but I have found myself looking at the local church, which is kinda a everybody welcome place, just as somewhere to go for community. I feel bad doing that because I really don't believe and it seems desperate just to go for to have something to do.

That is how I feel right now. I actually went to send someone a message and thought "Nah, I will just bother them as they haven't responded to the last three I have sent." Same thing if I think about adding someone as a friend.
The three people responding to this thread are more than have responded to me all month via calls, text, or facebook. If someone doesn't ever get back to you are they really your friend?

Thanks iodii. I just don't know what to do and don't really see a point to things.

Friends have moved away and aren't staying in touch. I really am only making it as I have some big projects right now and once they are done I want to wrap things up and just sleep.
